# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report privately. Do not open a public issue for a vulnerability.

- Use the repository's private vulnerability reporting (the Security tab on GitHub), or
- message the project on X at https://x.com/rouma_fun and ask for a private channel.

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the impact you expect. We aim to acknowledge a report within a few days and
will tell you what we plan to do about it.

## Scope

In scope:

- the static site in this repository and its build and check tools;
- anything that could make the page show an address, link or figure that is not a stated register record;
- cross-site scripting or injection through the search box or the register.

Out of scope:

- third-party hosting and font services;
- social engineering of maintainers;
- reports that only describe a missing figure that has not been stated yet.

## Addresses and impersonation

The only contract address Rouma recognises is the one stated in its register and shown in the slot at the top of rouma.fun.
Until that slot shows an address, treat any address presented as Rouma's with suspicion, including ones in chats and replies.
The team will never ask for a seed phrase or private key.

## Safe harbour

Good-faith research that avoids harming users, keeps data private and gives us time to fix the issue will not be pursued.
